description:
Pike gets off the stool and does not explain.

"Everyone thinks the rite is the sitting. It isn't. Anybody can sit. The rite is that you have been sat here long enough to know exactly where to put your hands, and then you go and put them there."

The Quartermaster has a charge on the counter and will not meet your eye while you pick it up.

The vats are the promise. Not the Spire, not the man at the top, not the money — the vats. It is where they keep the thing they actually sell, and everybody who has ever said yes to them said yes to that room. Bring the colonnade down. And the woman at the gate who has been pricing our people for six years, on your way out.

Then come home. That last part is not decoration; two of the three people who have done this did not manage it.

fail_on.desc: You died out there. The Watch will hear about it from Halcyon, which is the worst way for them to hear anything.
Too slow. The Spire had time to close, and a door that closes on the Watch stays closed for years.

name: Nothing Kept Back

objectives.desc: Take the charge off the Quartermaster's counter.
emotes: {who} picks up the charge. The Quartermaster finds something else to be doing.
{who} walks the concourse at the pace of somebody who is expected, which is the only pace that works.

objectives.desc: Wire the charge to the vat colonnade and bring it down.
emotes: {who} works along the colonnade with their back to the room, the way somebody works who belongs there.

objectives.desc: Actuary Verity Ives is at the gate. She is always at the gate.

emotes: {who} comes down the mirror-polished plaza steps at a walk, because running is what they look for.
{who} takes the road east with the sound still going on behind them.
